justification: Lifecycle states drive access changes per identity profile (pre-hire/active/leave/terminated/archived); vendor docs: "Lifecycle states describe a user's status in the organization, which you can use to drive access changes for your users."

justification: SoD exists only as access-package incompatibility (block a request based on existing group/package membership), not a general cross-app toxic-combination engine; vendor docs constrain it to Entra access packages and groups. justification: Built on Lifecycle Management plus Workflows; auto-provisions new hires to birthright apps and automates lifecycle tasks; vendor docs: "Automatically provision new employees to birthright apps based on their user profile attributes."
